scene.codegen: block merge and animation fusion on

visualCheck: Comparable idle-match black-background frames showed the three playable platforms, center terrain, side trees, native water, fighters and HUD in both modes. A static scene does not establish visibility across every camera zoom.
decision: Reject side scenery default promotion: opposing paired visible-FPS gains, no 60-FPS leg, and no separate long-running gameplay/zoom replay for this low-benefit candidate. Restore native side displays.
limits: Draw count is structural coverage, not exact CPU self-time. The fixed idle camera preview is not exhaustive visual verification of dynamic camera framing.
